overlooked_assumption: The agent assumed that normalizing the webhook URL to lowercase would preserve its validity, but Zapier webhook URLs contain case-sensitive path segments that become invalid when lowercased.
why_it_breaks: The validation schema applies .toLowerCase() to the webhookUrl field (line 46), which transforms the case-sensitive Zapier URL from 'https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/1234567/AbCdEfG/' to 'https://hooks.zapier.com/hooks/catch/1234567/abcdefg/', causing Zapier to return HTTP 404 because the path segment 'abcdefg' does not match the registered hook 'AbCdEfG'.
